title: The Mammoth Graveyard
text: Tusks rise out of the snow like a forest of ivory, hundreds of them curving up and over, yellow and white and cracked with age. The old beasts came here to die. Something still guards them; you can feel it watching from among the bones.

options.label: Take ivory from the dead; they came here to rest, not to hoard.

outcomes.text: You take as much as you can carry. The bones creak as you go, like something turning over in its sleep.
The guardian rises out of the bones.

options.label: The sharpest finds the guardian before anyone touches a tusk.

outcomes.text: It sleeps curled among the tusks. You take a little and go softly.

options.label: Leave the dead their ivory; it is all they have left.

outcomes.text: The wind drops as you go, and the feeling of being watched eases.
